text_block_list.name: Event Attendant
text_block_list.text:
Anyone wanting to attend the new book 
release talk show~?! We have one spot 
left!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait... That teacher is the one from the 
book I read the other day...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A talk show... I wanna listen to it...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I still have time before training, so just 
a little bit...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the talk show by the popular 
author began—

text_block_list.name: Popular Author
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, to give the story more depth, it 
is deliberately left unwritten.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Mm-hmm. That's why you imagine the 
protagonist's feelings in your own way, 
and end up connecting with them on such a 
deep level...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Especially when the protagonist was forced 
to make a decision—it was so thrilling 
being on the edge of my seat with them...!

text_block_list.name: Popular Author
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey you there! You're really getting 
into it, aren't ya~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no way... You heard that...? 
U-U-U-Um, I'm so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Popular Author
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you for the wonderful feedback! 
Would you mind telling me a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wah... w-well, then... just a little 
bit...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy got so caught up in the 
conversation that she ended up skipping 
her training...
